PRICE:
2025 Honda BR V Specs
Dimensions & Capacity
Overall length × width × height (mm): 4,490 × 1,780 × 1,651–1,677 (depending on variant) Wheelbase (mm): 2,700 Ground clearance: 207 mm Seating capacity: 7 persons Fuel tank capacity: 42 L
Engine & Powertrain Engine type: 1.5 liter DOHC i VTEC, 4 cylinder, 16 valve, gasoline Displacement: 1,498 cc Maximum output: ~119 hp at 6,600 rpm Maximum torque: 145 Nm at 4,300 rpm Transmission: 6 speed manual (S MT trim) or CVT (other trims) Drive type: Front wheel drive (FWD) Suspension / Brakes / Wheels / Tyres Front suspension: MacPherson strut Rear suspension: Torsion beam / torsion type Front brakes: Ventilated disc Rear brakes: Drum Tires / wheels: 215/60 R16 for basic trims; 17 inch alloy wheels for higher trims (e.g., VX trim) Features (typical, depending on trim) 7 inch Display Audio with Apple CarPlay / Android Auto / Bluetooth / USB / FM AM Power windows (front & rear) Power steering Adjustable steering column Upholstery: fabric (standard) or leather (higher trims) 3 row seating with foldable / tumble 2nd and 3rd row seats for flexible cargo/passenger configuration
